mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for drywall patching in my area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for drywall patching in cities like South San Francisco or Millbrae, look for general contractors with proven experience in drywall repair. Check for valid licenses, insurance, and positive client reviews or testimonials. Request detailed quotes from multiple contractors to compare pricing and proposed methods. A reputable contractor will communicate clearly, offer transparent pricing, and stand by their work with warranties, ensuring a quality repair.
